text:
A scientist needs to use a source of γ-rays as safely as possible.
Which action will not reduce the total radiation that reaches the scientist?
A
keeping the distance between the source and the scientist as large as possible
B
keeping the temperature of the source as low as possible
C
keeping the time for which the scientist uses the source as small as possible
D
placing a lead screen between the scientist and the source

options.label: A
options.text: keeping the distance between the source and the scientist as large as possible

options.label: B
options.text: keeping the temperature of the source as low as possible

options.label: C
options.text: keeping the time for which the scientist uses the source as small as possible

options.label: D
options.text: placing a lead screen between the scientist and the source
